title: He Choked His Only Friend Until He Begged . . . Then Hugged Him (Part 3)
caption:
A fourteen-year-old choked his only friend, then hugged him 😳 Part 3 of Swordmaster's Youngest Son. Follow for Part 4!

#swordmastersyoungestson #manhwarecap #manhwa #webtoon #regression #comicrecap #recap #fyp
credit: Swordmaster's Youngest Son (Hwangze Penguin / Mr. Big / AZI)
comment: Was Jin right to push Vellop that hard, or did he go too far? 👀 Comment below 👇

segments.say: Jin chokes his only friend until the boy gasps for air, and then *apologizes*.
Gilly was ready to shred the dragon in half. Now she bows and *begs* him for forgiveness.
Murakhan only laughs, and forgives his dear *strawberry* pie at once, just like that.
Jin explains it all, and Gilly learns about the dragon and the *library*.
Soon Jin leaves for the capital with Gilly, and a black *cat* rides his shoulder.
Then they reach the Mytell portal, a gate that sends people across kingdoms in *seconds*.
Then a man with a golden dragon crest walks in, and Jin's *eyes* go wide.
Gilly sees the crest on his cloak and whispers the one word she fears, *Zeifl*.
The cat claws the stranger's hand, and he hisses that he will *kill* it.
He is Veradeen Zeifl, a gifted sorcerer and Jin's old *rival* from his past life.
Jin gives him a cold glare, but Veradeen only grins and calls it a *joke*.
He says he would love to be Jin's friend, but their clans make that *impossible*.
Then the portal roars to life, and blue light carries Jin to the Runcandel *castle*.
Jin vows that this hellish place will not be so *terrible* this time.
Then his mother Rosa, the Dark *Panther*, stares at the cat on his shoulder.
His father squints and asks if it is a stray. Jin answers that the creature is in his *care*.
Then Jin names the cat Kitty Runcandel in front of everyone, and his siblings *explode*.
Jin says Kitty is his first claim, and whoever hurts it will *pay*.
His father grins, and warns the whole family to stay on their *toes*.
Four years later, Jin is fourteen, a two-star knight, and a novice *cadet*.
At lunch he sits beside Vellop Schmidtz, a thirteen-year-old commoner who apologizes for *everything*.
Vellop has the worst grades in class, and soon the clan may *banish* him.
In Jin's past life, Vellop was banished and later died by his own *hand*.
So Jin quietly promises himself that this time, Vellop will never be *banished*.
Then Instructor Garon announces a *test* set by Jin's mother, Dame Rosa.
Jin crushes cadet after cadet, then *snaps* Mesa Milcano's wooden sword with one strike.
Ten cadets fall, and Jin stands over the last one, thinking everything went to *plan*.
Garon congratulates him, but Jin asks for more time, because he wants one more *fight*.
Then Jin calls out Vellop Schmidtz in front of everyone, and the boy *trembles*.
Then Jin attacks with no warning, and every blow lands harder than the *last*.
Jin keeps coming, and Vellop is thrown across the yard in a spray of *blood*.
Jin only stands over him and says, do you think this is a sparring *match*?
Suddenly Vellop rises, and golden light wraps his wooden sword, the glow of *aura*.
He grits his teeth and *charges* at Jin with tears in his eyes.
Jin always knew Vellop held back to give the others a narrow *victory*.
Then Jin kicks the sword away, grabs Vellop by the throat, and *chokes* him.
Vellop coughs and begs Jin to finish it, asking if mocking him is *fun*.
Jin says it pains him too, but kindness alone cannot survive this *hell*.
He likes Vellop's kind heart, but warns him to show no *compassion* until he wins.
Then Jin kneels, hugs the boy, and says sorry for being so *harsh*.
Far away, Kahn reports the whole fight, and the patriarch bursts into *laughter*.
Then he orders Kahn to carry his word, because Jin gets his first *mission*.
A year later, Jin turns fifteen, and his swordsmanship is that of a three-star *knight*.
Luna shows him her own huge blade, the Slaughter of Bales, and Jin *stares*.
She raises Balisada, the black sword Jin once chose in the Rite of *Choice*.
But then she draws a golden blade, and Jin's face *freezes*.
It is Bradamante, the sword every Runcandel sibling covets. Jin planned to claim it by *any* means.
His siblings would block him if he picked it, but nobody can *question* Luna.
She says their siblings only trample each other, but Jin still has one *sister*.
Jin draws his new sword, and Murakhan snaps at him to put it *back*.
He shouts that nobody should wake that sword until his shadow force reaches *five* stars.
Murakhan grabs Jin's head in anger, so Jin snatches his precious comic *book*.
Gilly rushes in and finds a mighty dragon weeping over his *comic*.
Gilly tells Jin that Instructor Garon has assigned him his first *mission*.
Strange, since cadets only get missions after intermediate classes, and Jin has not *started*.
He walks into a room where ten *cadets* and Garon wait around a map.
Ten novice cadets, in two groups, must scout the southern border of the *Jian* Kingdom.
But the marked area sits right beside the den of the White *Werewolves*.
Jin realizes this is no accident, because somebody gave a very *specific* order.
Someone picked this border and these weak cadets, and Jin fears it was his *father*.
